svg.title: DNS: a 12-byte header, a question, a record
svg.desc: The DNS response of frame 2 of dns_query_response.pcapng, 32 bits per row: the 12-byte header, transaction identifier 0x180f, flags 0x8180 and four counts, one question and one answer; the question, the name wireshark.org as two labels and a root label, then its type and class; the answer, whose name is the two bytes c0 0c, a compression pointer to offset 12, then type A, class IN, a TTL of 14400 seconds, a data length of 4 and the address 128.121.50.122; DnsPacket keeps the header, the question and the answer with its name rebuilt.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
